//: User-facing list of /keel commands for the docs site. Edit with SKILL.md's mode headings; keep usage strings identical.

commands.name: New project
commands.summary: Interviews you about a new idea, then writes a tailored, cross-referenced set of docs to build from: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, requirements, architecture, decision records, plan, deployment, runbook and more.

commands.name: Version
commands.summary: Shows the installed keel version, the version that last updated this project's docs, doc sizes against their budgets, and whether a newer user-facing release exists.

commands.name: Phase
commands.summary: Scopes a new build phase: a plan block with exit gates, reserved decision-record numbers, and a workflow script. Insert after a phase or split one.

commands.name: Change
commands.summary: Logs a hotfix-sized piece of work without a phase: its own branch, a change row, a CHANGELOG line and a small workflow script.

commands.name: Closeout
commands.summary: Turns the open deferred items into a closeout phase, so postponed work gets scheduled instead of forgotten.

commands.name: Upgrade
commands.summary: Audits existing keel docs against the current keel standard, reports the gaps, and applies the fixes you approve, including older doc-format migrations.

commands.name: Archive
commands.summary: Moves finished or superseded detail out of the living docs into archives, and splits docs that are still over budget. Nothing is deleted; every move leaves a link.
